Maker product page headline 'PRICES FROM: £4,250 | $6,000 | €4,600' is the non-assist trike; e-assist price from the maker's 2026 USD price list PDF (read in-browser via pdf.js; quote is extracted text with double spaces). Maker gives no range figure and sizes by X-seam, not height. Weight is the lightest non-assist build. Independent source RAD Innovations (dealer) is an older page (mentions 2018, Shimano E6000/E8000), so used only for frame specs that match the maker (weight, load, X-seam, fold).
